corpusAnswer: to{} drink | swallow/gulp | take-medicine | keep-down/suppress | accept

sourceData.answer: to{} drink/gulp/swallow/take-(medicine) | smoke-(tobacco) | engulf/overwhelm | keep-down/suppress | accept-(e.g.-demand,-condition) | make-light-of/conceal
sourceData.mnemonic: This word consists of kanji with hiragana attached. Because the hiragana ends with an <ja>う</ja> sound, you know this word is a verb. The kanji itself means <kanji>drink</kanji> so the vocab verb version is <vocabulary>to drink</vocabulary>.
sourceData.readingMnemonic: The reading is the same as the one you learned with the kanji. Go have a drink in the great Allicrab's name!
